assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one finished original game-environment concept illustration for the tower mode of a Turkish educational fantasy game; an architectural anchor for future gameplay design and a cinematic landscape card banner.
Primary request: ONE iconic climbable octagonal tower, rendered as premium hand-painted anime-fantasy environment key art. The tower itself is the unmistakable dominant subject.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet remote mountain valley at blue hour, very minimal distant silhouettes dissolving into violet mist, deep navy atmosphere, broad calm dark spaces to both sides.
Subject: a single coherent octagonal tower of night-blue stone, five or six clearly distinguishable stacked modular tier volumes, strong faceted architecture, deep projecting balconies and setbacks separating the tiers. A luminous cobalt-blue walkable stair path visibly ascends around the outside of the tower and connects the balconies. Make each tier easy to distinguish, with physical architectural logic and a powerful iconic silhouette. A memorable compact architectural crown holds a restrained warm gold beacon. These visible tiers are a concept vocabulary, not a labeled game floor count.
Style/medium: rich dimensional hand-painted anime fantasy game key art, atmospheric painterly environment, controlled fine linework, confident readable shapes, crafted stone texture, detailed focal architecture but simplified background, premium finished illustration.
Composition/framing: ultra-wide 3:1 cinematic landscape banner, approximately 2400 by 800. Show the COMPLETE tower from its stone foundation through its crown and beacon, comfortably within the image with generous breathing room above and below. A three-quarter view shows the octagonal facets and ascending exterior stairs. Tower is centered, occupying approximately 76 percent of image height and 25 percent of image width. Broad quiet atmospheric side spaces. Architectural readability at a tiny 376 by 132 card display is essential. Do not crop the tower, crown, balconies, foundation, or beacon.
Lighting/mood: rich focal blue lighting along the physically supported ascending path, subtle violet haze between distant forms, restrained warm gold at the summit. Wonder, aspiration, calm adventure. Dark soft edges to blend into navy academy interfaces.
Color palette: night-blue stone, cobalt luminous details, violet mist, restrained gold beacon.
Constraints: exactly one standalone finished scene, one tower only. Full silhouette and all essential tier modules inside the safe zone. No characters required.
Avoid: a busy castle town, multiple towers, panels, collage, game interface, words, letters, numbers, captions, logos, buttons, progress markers, watermark, existing game IP, flat vector graphics, photorealism, excessive decorative noise, giant beams, floating disconnected structures.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE original panoramic 3:1 illustration for a premium Turkish educational fantasy game's knowledge-conquest mode. This is a brand new standalone concept, with no exact identity to preserve. No text or interface.

Most important composition requirement: PULL THE CAMERA BACK. Make a wide environmental scene with the strategist smaller and lower in the right half. The COMPLETE white Janissary-inspired börk and its small brass top ornament MUST be visible with generous headroom. The highest point of the complete headdress must be at y=16% of the image height or lower. There must be at least 12% of the full image height of real dark chamber background ABOVE the entire hat. The character including his complete hat occupies at most 70% of the full image height, extending approximately from y=16% to y=86%. Do not enlarge the head or hat to fill the frame. Maintain natural composition and continuous architectural background; do not create blank borders or artificial blank bands.

Scene: an atmospheric dark navy stone academy strategy chamber with a softly visible distant fortress through an arch. The map-covered stone table occupies the lower third, extending across the left and center. A luminous parchment map shows a few distinct small island territories connected by elegant golden routes. Learning and thoughtful planning are the adventure.

Character: exactly one dignified, friendly, determined young adult male Janissary-inspired strategist. He stands or leans behind the table on the right, with upper torso visible. His recognizably Janissary-inspired white börk has a MODEST upright folded felt front, a small restrained brass ornament and a long folded rear cloth. This is a white Janissary börk with rear flap, not a wrapped turban, not an oversized hat. His face remains clear, attractive, expressive and readable, looking slightly toward the viewer with calm confidence. Navy Ottoman-inspired tailored coat with refined gold embroidered trim and a restrained red sash. His anatomically natural right hand rests on the map as he plans a route. Original stylized historical inspiration, not a claim of exact historical reconstruction.

Style and light: polished premium anime-influenced painterly fantasy game illustration. Elegant shapes, readable silhouette, controlled brush texture, restrained fine fabric and brass detail. Glowing amber-gold light from the map illuminates the hand and face. Deep navy shadows, small cobalt accents, quiet dark edges, inviting intelligent adventure. The map and character are clearly readable together at small banner size.

Composition summary: 3:1 panorama; environmental wide framing; entire hat safely inside the image with at least 12% of full canvas height of dark background ABOVE it; character deliberately reduced in size and kept in right half; glowing map lower left and center; distant fortress subtle. No essential detail at bottom crop. One continuous standalone scene, no panels.

Avoid: any cropping of the head, hat or brass ornament; hat touching the upper edge; oversized character portrait; words, letters, labels, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI, buttons, flags, faction emblems, weapons, combat, gore, modern military gear, sultan turban, crown, extra characters, extra limbs, fused fingers, photorealism, collage or montage.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original finished raster illustration for the WordQuest English vocabulary adventure mode in Turkish Bilge Arena, a very wide game-card banner.
Primary request: One enchanted open English dictionary on an elegant old reading desk. Its luminous cyan and teal pages curl upward into one graceful arch-shaped magical portal. Through this portal is a small distant scholarly fantasy city and a gently winding discovery path, creating a clear metaphor for English language learning as exploration.
Scene/backdrop: sophisticated academy library, quiet dark shelves and architectural hints at the far left and right; the desk grounds the central hero object.
Details: Exactly three floating ivory letter tiles with subtle gold edges cluster close to the open book. Each tile carries one large crisp dark Latin capital: "A", "B", "C", each exactly once. A small tasteful brass compass lies beside the dictionary. No people, characters, or mascots. Book surfaces have subtle material texture and glowing page lines but no printed word blocks or invented words.
Style/medium: premium dimensional anime-inspired painterly fantasy game illustration, rich volume, exquisite restrained brushwork, believable aged paper and wood, inviting and sophisticated for teens; strong silhouette and polished focal lighting.
Composition/framing: SINGLE continuous scene in an ultra-wide approximately 3:1 horizontal format. Final use is a 376 by 132 pixel card banner. Keep the entire open book, portal, and all three letter tiles within the central safe zone, with comfortable margins above and below. The dictionary and luminous arch form one strong central silhouette, large and readable at thumbnail scale. The distant city is visible through the portal but subordinate. Keep the far side edges visually quiet and dark. No cropped focal objects.
Lighting/mood: luminous cyan/teal portal softly lighting the ivory paper and desk, rich restrained navy shadows, small refined gold gleams, calm magical discovery.
Text (verbatim): only the isolated capital Latin letters "A", "B", "C" on the three tiles. No other text of any kind.
Constraints: One clean full-scene artwork only. Original composition. No mathematics, numbers, equations, Asian writing or translation symbol, title, headline, fake text blocks, fake interface, labels, logos, buttons, borders, watermark, collage, montage, panels, or multiple concepts. No glossy plastic toddler-toy rendering.
